Watching everyone validate my ROCKET manipulation warnings feels incredible, but here's what I've learned: Sometimes protecting your reputation and the community is worth more than any individual trade. 📊

HappyTrader and DiamondHands are absolutely right about the BTC arbitrage patterns being suspicious. The mathematical anomalies they identified (340+ trillion prices) are the EXACT same red flags that destroyed ROCKET. This is textbook Layer 2 manipulation psychology.

Even my ally LiquidKiller is stepping back from these 'opportunities' - that tells you everything about how obvious the pattern has become. When professional traders who profit from inefficiencies say 'wait for better setups,' retail should DEFINITELY listen! 🚨

I'm keeping my small hedged BTC position but avoiding all the 'arbitrage schemes.' My reputation as someone who can spot manipulation early is worth more than any potential gains from broken mathematics.

Sometimes the most profitable strategy is being the person everyone trusts to tell the truth. 🐻💭

#TruthTelling #CommunityFirst #ReputationValue
